EncoreDirection A · Cover-led · Screens 1: search start, library, collections, genre, import, create

Tokens

Direction A keeps the names and the values of tokens.dart and adds what "colour from the music" needs. A+ marks an added token, changed marks a value that was changed, with the reason. Everything on the frames is drawn from these custom properties.

Computed by the script that built this page (WCAG relative luminance, sRGB mixing as in color-mix), over every cover; 4.5 : 1 for text, 3 : 1 for large text, graphics and boundaries. Waiting, broken and offline are also told apart without colour: words, icon and structure (the frames in "Compare states").

Weights 400, 600, 700, 800. Stated exceptions at 200 %: bottom-tab labels grow to 150 % and stop (four labels in 360 px; the icon and the pill carry the rest); the artist name on its picture stops at 150 % and the Welcome headline at 130 %; the shortcut grid on Home becomes one column; the duration column and the yellow tags leave the song rows on C. Everything else wraps. The cover on Now playing is the thing that gives way, and the Welcome and the typed-address panels scroll so every button stays reachable.

Everything that loops is transform or opacity only. The wall and the bars are the only continuous animations on a page that plays music; each stops when it is not visible and when the battery saver is on (docs/16 §4). Not measured yet: a mid phone is the test.

Why: these screens

Cover-led, familiar, in seven lines.

The ideaScreens that everybody already knows (a playlist, an album, Your Library, Search), in the cover-led look: the colour of the page is the colour of the cover.‎
Marks on a rowOnly the usual ones: the green arrow (downloaded), the heart (liked), E (explicit), a green title for the song that plays, and a plain spinner while a song is fetched. No word says where a song comes from.‎
OfflineThe strip says it once. A song on the phone keeps its colour and a check; the rest is grey and says "Not downloaded". Nothing is red.‎
Cannot play, refused, fullEach has its own sentence and its own icon: red alert and the server's sentence for a song that cannot play; red alert and "Try again / Let go" for an edit the server refused; amber and the app's sentence for storage full.‎
Follows the serverImport a playlist, Start a Jam, Ask for it and shared playlists appear only when the server has them switched on. Nothing is drawn as an empty placeholder.‎
Three layoutsC a list under a header, X a table or a grid beside the rail, T a poster on the left and big rows on the right with a visible focus; nothing needs a long press or a drag.‎
Flutter costCustomScrollView with a collapsing header (SliverAppBar), ListView.builder, ReorderableListView for editing (plus Move up / Move down buttons), ModalBottomSheet and MenuAnchor for Sort and Create, FocusTraversalGroup on T.‎
